canonical.name: On this page a signed measure may take at most one infinite sign, while a complex measure is finite-valued by definition
A null set for a signed measure means every measurable subset has signed measure 0, not merely the ambient set
Total variation is defined by countable measurable partitions; finite partitions collapse to the same value only in the signed case
